_why: Row 2816: h_mad_reanchor_diff.py reports a re-anchored mutation row whose edit delta changed: the tokens added differ, or neither removed set contains the other. Each mutant removes one part of that judgement.

mutations.name: R1: ADDED TOKENS IGNORED. The 2026-10-25 shape: same anchors, replace now breaks a different guard, read SAME.
R2: REMOVED TOKENS IGNORED. A mutant that now deletes unrelated code reads SAME.
R3: EXACT EQUALITY. The strict rule: a deleted statement that legitimately grew reads CHANGED (7/10 noise in calibration).
mutations.find: nested = not (was_removed - now_removed) or not (now_removed - was_removed)

mutations.name: R4: WHITESPACE COUNTS. Tokenizing on raw characters makes `f(a,b)` vs `f(a, b)` read CHANGED.
R5: A NEW OR RENAMED ROW READS SAME. Rows with no same-named base row are skipped instead of reported cannot-judge.
mutations.find: unjudged.append(f"{spec_arg} :: {name} (no row of that name at {base})")

mutations.name: R6: AN UNREADABLE SPEC READS SAME. Bad JSON is swallowed as a spec with no rows.
